discovery_notes: Loungefly 2023 cell. 30 standard searches, all claims search_snippet. Mystery designs recorded only where a listing names each design or states set size alongside the named list; Ep1-2-3 held (names and count from different sources). Infinity Saga is corroboration of 225_b096 key only. Hot Topic Pooh sets recorded with maker unconfirmed. NBC 30th / Han Solo / LM BoxLunch items left as leads (year not stated). Keys for Disney100 glitter/anniversary, Disney100 platinum and Haunted Mansion stretching-room blind box aligned with parallel packet 251_b081 (same products) so claims corroborate rather than duplicate; 251 names the HM set 'Icons' while DPB/yourWDWstore call it Stretching Room Portraits - same six designs.
